import re

def parse_duration(s: str) -> int:
    pattern = r'^\s*(?:(\d+)h)?\s*(?:(\d+)m)?\s*(?:(\d+)s)?\s*$'
    match = re.fullmatch(pattern, s, re.IGNORECASE)
    
    if not match:
        raise ValueError("Invalid duration format")
        
    h_str, m_str, s_str = match.groups()
    
    if not any([h_str, m_str, s_str]):
        raise ValueError("Duration must contain at least one valid unit")

import re
import unicodedata

def slugify(title: str, max_len: int = 50) -> str:
    # 1 & 2: Transliterate accented characters to ASCII and lowercase
    text = unicodedata.normalize('NFKD', title).encode('ascii', 'ignore').decode('ascii').lower()
    
    # 3: Replace every run of characters other than a-z and 0-9 with a single '-', strip leading/trailing '-'
    text = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]+', '-', text).strip('-')
    
    if not text:
        return ''
        
    # 4: Shorten without cutting a word
    words = text.split('-')
    parts = []
    current_len = 0
    
    for word in words:
        if len(word) > max_len:
            # Hard-cut if even the first word exceeds max_len
            parts.append(word[:max_len])
            break
        sep_len = 1 if current_len > 0 else 0
        if current_len + len(word) + sep_len <= max_len:
            parts.append(word)
            current_len += len(word) + sep_len
        else:
            break
            
    # 5: Result never ends with '-'
    return '-'.join(parts)
